name: web-digest
description: Answers a WebFetch call with a short digest instead of Claude's own page pass: the web-digest skill script fetches the public page with Obscura (text), trims it in code and asks the free router the question. Any failure, a private or loopback URL, or a read-on request lets Claude's own WebFetch run unchanged. Does nothing unless the web-digest skill and Obscura are installed. Reads .ai-dev-kit.json; the mod itself reads no env and makes no network call. Runs: node web-digest/cli.js.
